claims.statement: All 181 bundled records pass byte-preservation, coverage, mutation, and lexical extraction tests; source-bound prose descriptions cover every record, refresh only description metadata, reject stale bindings, and reproduce the public guide. English-to-Alloy semantic equivalence is not mechanically claimed.

The 378 frozen Java regression assertions, all 181 canonical starter comparisons plus 181 oracle self-comparisons, and expanded-trace witnesses satisfy their assertions; matrix unit edits replay privately against the target under the selected variable and child alignments, while public context remains learner-derived. Raw AST enumeration and parser/corpus coverage are separately bound by C-AST.
The frozen body-validation and HTTP tests pass for public projections, private-path isolation, request limits, worker failure handling, malformed UTF-8/JSON and comment escapes.

Frozen mock transport and HTTP fixtures check learner-only educational context and validated spans, per-operation and per-instance structured descriptions with complete unique ID coverage, bounded hints, obvious solution-shaped output refusal, exact cached witness binding, request rejection, credentials, caching, capacity, and sanitized failures. Live prose truth and universal solution prevention are excluded.

The exact frozen Playwright browser workflow assertions pass in desktop and mobile Chromium sessions, including paired highlights at the selected repeated source/canonical occurrence and rejection of ambiguous single-node claims. The virtual-application fixture serves the actual packaged HTML and poisons stale unversioned asset URLs; the UI must load content-versioned assets and complete its feedback/navigation/download workflow. Metric-switch, stale-response, request-identity and real AST fixtures check distinct distance modes and source-only AST edit locations; dashboard behavior is separately tested under C-CICD.

Two isolated fresh copies of the frozen inputs build and package successfully and produce identical class files, web assets, IIS ZIP/checksum files, inventories, provenance, correspondence metadata, and claim-status sets.
Frozen input hashes, evidence bindings, trust classification, witnesses, provenance, network isolation, and negative decision controls satisfy the registered finite closure checks.

Vendor files match the frozen delivered snapshot manifest, based on ACGN commit 1e2667351532b0c632166fa21ae5fbc7308a8fe7 plus the local parser-origin presentation metadata patch; equality to the upstream commit is not claimed. The frozen delivery-source credential filename/token-pattern checks pass, Git ignore rules admit the bundled exercise data and exclude credentials, and the bundled data retain their expected coverage and source witnesses. A source-only temporary Git repository cloned with core.autocrlf=true preserves Bash entrypoint/corpus bytes and every hash-bound vendor input; this Linux-executed checkout fixture is not native Windows execution.

The frozen Linux-executed IIS package and proxy-compatibility assertions pass for deterministic archives, manifest hashes, public/private file isolation, rejected inputs, explicit proxy origins, UTF-8 runtime/key handling, packaged runtime feedback, private corpus import and validated ZIP restoration with source-independent existing-data checks and actionable sanitized failures, bounded HTTP diagnosis without response-body disclosure, and the same-process task launcher configuration and sanitized failure behavior; actual Windows/IIS execution is excluded. The source build chain automatically refreshes the archive from fresh compiled classes, forwards custom output paths, and preserves the previous archive on failed builds. Packaged HTML references JS/CSS by exact content SHA-256 query versions, changes those URLs when payloads change despite fixed ZIP timestamps, and binds them in the manifest; XML fixtures require static no-cache/no-store, disabled timestamp ETags and disabled IIS output caches. Actual IIS and Cloudflare cache behavior is excluded.

The frozen private pool verifier checks all 181 pools and 7731 candidate source/context/body witnesses, exactly one explicit oracle per pool, corpus-correct source labels, deterministic ordering, and declared exclusion witnesses; correctness of corpus labels and oracles is trusted.

Frozen real-JVM minimum-selection assertions, all 181 complete starter-pool comparisons with included-oracle upper bounds, winner-trace privacy/replay, alternative-correct zero matches, fail-closed pool errors, and HTTP/Luna pool-boundary assertions pass. Minimum means the admitted finite pool including its oracle, not all semantic solutions.

Frozen synthetic-key tests check private JSON and key-file loading, deployment-relative paths after relocation, explicit precedence and fail-closed malformed configuration, credential-scoped explanation caches, ignored private config and HTTP isolation. Filesystem privacy on Windows depends on installer ACLs; actual Windows execution and cryptographic at-rest secrecy are excluded.

Frozen relocated-package and fresh-source assertions verify all seven pinned dependency JARs, reject each missing or corrupted JAR including redundant AlloyASG archives, reject missing compiled entry classes and unavailable Java, and run 378 engine checks using explicit bundled classpaths with poisoned ambient paths excluded. Windows build structural assertions require dependency preflight and explicit platform-separated JAR paths; actual Windows execution is outside this Linux test surface. Simulated Windows Bash launchers exercise both real shell entry points and check delegation to native PowerShell, absolute path conversion, output semantics, and propagated failures. The shared compiler fixtures check clean staging, stale-class removal, safe output promotion, explicit compiler arguments, and failure preservation.

Frozen Linux tests create a temporary Git repository and clone its complete bundled exercise data into a path with spaces, then run setup and startup without an IIS archive, Node, or original ACGN corpus. They check all 181 exercise records, pool witnesses and included oracles, real engine checks and HTTP feedback, solution/credential HTTP isolation, and terminal shutdown. Additional fixtures retain ZIP restoration, sanitized Java options, and macOS JDK discovery/failure checks; native macOS execution is excluded.

Frozen JVM and HTTP projection assertions check recorded canonical child paths selecting the corresponding rendered nodes and retained learner parser origins, including repeated-text occurrences, removed or merged origins, and fixture canonical-form/distance agreement with presentation metadata erased. They also check explicit related, ambiguous, unavailable and whole-form context, literal-preserving canonical whitespace compaction with UTF-16 rebasing, invalid-range and ambiguous-node rejection, source/target isolation, and locations bound to the checked draft. Browser interaction is discharged separately by C-BROWSER. Universal provenance preservation, proof of a source defect, and executable repair correctness are excluded.

Frozen JVM and HTTP fixtures check the ACGN reward formula with model facts enforced, sampled-perfect semantic correction, rounded scores, bounded oracle/learner categories and temporal witnesses, private metadata exclusion, invalid evidence rejection, and independent worker/cache behavior. Browser interaction is discharged by C-BROWSER. Unbounded equivalence and equality to upstream fact-omitting behavior are excluded.

Frozen JVM tests compare unit node distances and private trace replay against an independent exhaustive ordered-mapping oracle for all 10,404 pairs of two-label ordered trees with one through four nodes. Parser fixtures check retained Body/NOOP structure, operand order, identifier spelling, repeated-node source positions, promotion/adoption, target redaction, limits and fail-closed pool errors. Every shipped exercise has starter/oracle and oracle-identity AST comparisons; a largest real pool and bounded synthetic inclusive pools check complete nearest-candidate evaluation and ties. These finite assertions are not a Lean proof, universal optimality proof, semantic Alloy equivalence claim, or executable textual repair guarantee.

Frozen worker, HTTP, cache and mocked Luna fixtures require explicit canonical/AST routing, canonical default behavior, rejection of unknown or mismatched worker metrics, per-metric cache identity, selected-trace educational evidence and complete operation IDs without hidden target fields. Browser mode-switch races and rendering are covered separately by C-BROWSER. Live model availability, prose truth and universal solution prevention remain excluded.

Frozen local fixtures check safe dashboard summary allowlists, missing/malformed/symlinked reports, clean-revision binding, historical closure labeling, suppressed process-output disclosure, tag/version agreement and public artifact path constraints. Seven local Chromium scenarios check honest missing and stale states, mocked workflow/release metadata, safe links, rate-limit failure behavior, no automatic external fetch, and IIS application-prefix assets. Workflow source assertions require pinned official actions, read-only permissions, secretless tests and dashboard-only upload paths. Actual GitHub Actions execution, repository/org settings, remote artifact publication and production deployment are outside this offline closure. Loopback HTTP fixtures check the dashboard index, relative trailing-slash redirect, exact four-file serving allowlist, traversal/private-file refusal, current bytes/content types and dashboard-confined GitHub connection policy. Windows command-selection fixtures choose Bash beside Git for standard and portable layouts and fail closed instead of selecting an unrelated System32 WSL launcher.

Frozen metadata assertions check the 24-entry Lean obligation register has unique IDs and planned theorem names, acyclic existing references, repository-local implementation paths, dependency-closed raw-AST and full-portal profiles, exact documentation/table/toolchain-pin agreement and honest dashboard counts. Every obligation must remain OPEN with empty evidence and formalClosureStatus NOT_ESTABLISHED. The finite regression proof inventory and required correspondence count remain empty/zero. No Lean compiler, kernel check, theorem validity or implementation-to-proof refinement is discharged by these tests.
